items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Willie Jackson, I heard the name, I don't know.

ctx.x: Yeah. It's really nice. Something you should hear. I mean, it's got nice sentiment in it, you know. It describes a town. Good town. We were just about out of tape here. Yeah, I thought we were. I thought you might remember New Orleans' Willie Jackson, he used to entertain at that.
Willie Jackson, I heard the name, I don't know.
Tom Anderson, he was an entertainer there with another phone.
